title: Gerente Executivo de Inteligência Operacional
description:
Na RD Saúde , você vai acelerar seu aprendizado em um ambiente dinâmico, com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional.


Somos líderes no mercado brasileiro de farmácias, com lojas em todo o país e mais de 60 mil pessoas apaixonadas por cuidar de gente. Trilhamos um caminho de desenvolvimento que impulsiona carreiras e transforma futuros. Juntos por uma sociedade de mais saudável impactamos mais de 1 milhão de vidas e queremos ir ainda mais longe — de forma sólida, humana e lado a lado com você. Venha fazer parte dessa jornada e trilhar um caminho que transforma.


Principais Responsabilidades:

1. Mapeamento, Padronização e Melhoria Contínua de Processos

• Mapear, analisar, redesenhar e otimizar processos ponta a ponta, garantindo eficiência operacional, conformidade regulatória, escalabilidade e foco no cliente interno.

• Atuar de forma transversal junto às lideranças das áreas, promovendo visão integrada dos fluxos, redução de retrabalhos, mitigação de riscos operacionais e financeiros e diminuição de tempos de ciclo.

• Abranger processos das seguintes áreas: Contas a Pagar, Contas a Receber, Fiscal e Tributário, Custos, Contabilidade, Legalização de Lojas, Folha de Pagamento e Benefícios

• Atendimento de chamados provenientes das Lojas e Centros de Distribuição (CSC), incluindo demandas de folha, benefícios, manutenção de lojas e rotinas administrativas e operacionais.

• Implementar metodologias de melhoria contínua e excelência operacional, garantindo padronização e sustentabilidade dos ganhos.


2. Liderança das Frentes de Automação, Inteligência Artificial e Dados

• Liderar a célula de Automação, Inteligência Artificial e Dados, atualmente com aproximadamente 400 robôs em produção, assegurando: governança do pipeline de automações, estabilidade e resiliência operacional, e evolução tecnológica contínua e mensuração estruturada de ganhos de produtividade e retorno sobre investimento (ROI).

• Definir, priorizar e executar o roadmap estratégico de automação e uso de IA aplicada a processos administrativos, financeiros e operacionais.

• Coordenar a estratégia de dados da diretoria, incluindo:

• Desenvolvimento e evolução de BI’s executivos e operacionais

• Gestão de data lake e fontes de dados

• Definição e monitoramento de indicadores de desempenho, produtividade, SLA, qualidade e eficiência


3. Políticas, Normas e Governança de Processos

• Estruturar, revisar e manter políticas, normas e procedimentos da diretoria, assegurando: conformidade legal, regulatória e fiscal, padronização operacional em larga escala e clareza de papéis, responsabilidades e níveis de decisão.

• Atuar como guardião dos processos críticos, garantindo sua correta aplicação, atualização contínua e aderência às melhores práticas de mercado.


4. Governança, Metas e Gestão Executiva

• Estruturar e liderar o modelo de governança da diretoria, incluindo: definição e gestão de metas, KPIs e OKRs, rituais de acompanhamento, fóruns executivos e comitês de decisão e monitoramento de performance e direcionamento estratégico.

• Gerir o orçamento da área, incluindo investimentos em tecnologia, automação, dados e projetos de melhoria contínua.

• Elaborar e apresentar materiais executivos para diretoria e comitês, com visão analítica, estratégica e orientada a dados.


5. Gestão de Projetos e Evolução de Sistemas

• Liderar projetos estratégicos de implementação, evolução e otimização de sistemas que suportam o CSC e Suprimentos Indiretos, incluindo: ERPs, sistemas fiscais, financeiros e de folha de pagamento, plataformas de chamados, automação e analytics.

• Atuar como interface entre áreas de negócio, tecnologia e fornecedores, assegurando entregas dentro de prazo, custo, escopo e qualidade esperados.

• Garantir alinhamento entre soluções tecnológicas e objetivos estratégicos do negócio.


Requisitos:

  • Superior completo.
  • Experiência executiva sólida em: Centros de Serviços Compartilhados, processos financeiros, administrativos, contábeis e fiscais, transformação operacional em ambientes complexos e de grande escala.
  • Liderança de iniciativas de automação, dados e analytics.
  • Vivência em organizações com alto nível de governança, controles e exigências regulatórias.
  • Desejável formação complementar ou certificações em: Gestão de Processos (BPM, Lean, Six Sigma), Gestão de Projetos (PMI, PMP, Agile, Scrum).
  • Automação de Processos (RPA).
  • Data Analytics, BI e Inteligência Artificial aplicada a negócios.
  • Governança, Riscos e Compliance.

title: Local Technical Support - IT
description:
Job Opportunity: Local Technical Support

We are looking for a proactive Local Technical Support professional to join our Service Delivery team in Rio de Janeiro. This is a full-time, temporary role reporting to the Technology Manager.


Role Overview

As the primary point of contact for end-users and VIPs, you will manage incidents and service requests, ensuring high levels of satisfaction through technical excellence and effective communication.

Main Activities & Responsibilities

  • User Support: Act as the single point of contact for all IT incidents and requests, including attending the IT Welcome Desk and supporting VIP users.
  • Ticket Management: Log, prioritize, and resolve assigned tickets within agreed SLAs, keeping users informed of progress.
  • Technical Maintenance: Install, configure, and troubleshoot end-user devices (laptops, tablets, mobile devices, printers) and network equipment.
  • System Administration: Perform user account management (creation and deletion) and manage access permissions across various platforms.
  • Operations: Maintain hardware and software inventories, manage IT assets, and provide support according to shift schedules.
  • Knowledge Sharing: Conduct IT inductions for new joiners and create technical guidelines and procedures.

Technical Skills & Qualifications

  • Education: ITIL certification is preferred.
  • OS Knowledge: Hands-on experience with Windows 10/11 and macOS.
  • Infrastructure: Proficiency in Active Directory, Microsoft Office 365, ServiceNow, Intune, Autopilot, SCCM, and JAMF.
  • Mobile & AV: Knowledge of Android and iOS platforms and familiarity with video conferencing equipment.
  • Experience: Minimum of 3 years of experience in IT support roles, specifically supporting senior management and VIPs.
  • Languages: Must be fluent in English and Portuguese.

Competencies

  • Excellent customer service skills (empathy, diplomacy, and active listening).
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.
  • Quick learner with high technical aptitude.

title: PESSOA GERENTE DE CONTROLADORIA INDUSTRIAL
description:

Buscamos talentos que possam transformar possibilidades em realidade, que contribuam para nos manter como a melhor e mais completa empresa farmacêutica brasileira, participando da vida das pessoas para que elas vivam mais e melhor.


Essa oportunidade está aberta à candidatura de todas as pessoas, independentemente de orientação sexual, acessibilidade social ou de qualquer outro fator.


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD's).


Você não se identificou com essa vaga? Não se preocupe! Você ainda pode fazer parte do nosso time! Inscreva-se no nosso banco de talentos e assim que surgir uma oportunidade que tenha mais a ver com você, nós entraremos em contato!

  • Estimular uso de analytics, BI e automação para ganho de eficiência e qualidade das informações.

Gestão de Indicadores e Resultados

  • Propor, monitorar e aprimorar KPIs que direcionam as decisões desde o chão de fábrica até diretoria.

  • Atuar em frentes essenciais: processo de S&OP como parceiro financeiro, conectando decisões operacionais a margem, capital de giro e geração de caixa. Adicionalmente apoiar a otimização e giro de estoques, gestão de descartes, benchmarkings, entre outros
  • Buscar e implementar oportunidades de eficiência fabril e redução de despesas industriais.

  • Graduação em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência Profissional

  • Sólida Vivência em: Controladoria, Custos, Planejamento Financeiro ou áreas correlatas.
  • Vivência em ambientes industriais (farmacêutico é um grande diferencial).
  • Experiência em liderança de equipes e atuação colaborativa com áreas operacionais.

Competências e Habilidades

  • Sólida capacidade analítica e visão sistêmica.

  • Perfil líder, comunicativo, influente e orientado a resultados.
  • Mão na massa, organizado(a), com senso de urgência e forte capacidade de execução.

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
About Client

Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.


The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion.

You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance.

Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.g., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption).

You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics.


About You

  • You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused.
  • You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success.
  • You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs.
  • You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities.
  • You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement.


Requirements

title: Procurement Manager
description:
Work Location : São Paulo, Brazil

Report To : JD Industrial Brazil Business Leader

Business Type : Cross-border Industrial Supply Chain / MRO Industrial Products Procurement & Sales

I. Business Introduction

JD Industrial is the core business segment of JD Group focusing on industrial supply chain technology and services. We have established a localized operation system in Brazil , focusing on providing end-to-end MRO industrial product supply chain solutions for Chinese-funded overseas enterprises and local large-scale manufacturing/energy/infrastructure enterprises.

  • Core Positioning : Serve customers in Brazil's manufacturing, energy, mining, infrastructure and other industries, providing one-stop procurement, cross-border/local fulfillment, inventory management, supply chain finance and other services for full-category MRO (Maintenance, Repair, Operations) industrial products.
  • Core Advantages : Relying on JD's global supply chain network, local warehousing, distribution and compliance capabilities in Brazil , and digital procurement platform, we solve the pain points of the Brazilian market such as high prices, long delivery times, scattered suppliers and complex certifications .
  • Business Scope : Covering full MRO categories including tools, labor protection, electrical, hydraulic, transmission, chemical, and spare parts , supporting the dual model of cross-border procurement + local procurement , and realizingfast delivery, compliant customs clearance and credit period settlement in Brazil.

II. Key Job Responsibilities

1. Development and Management of Local MRO Suppliers in Brazil (Core)

  • In-depth development of local MRO suppliers in Brazil (tools, electrical, labor protection, hydraulic, transmission, chemical, spare parts, etc.), and establishment of a localized supplier resource pool.
  • Responsible for supplier access, evaluation, negotiation, signing, maintenance and elimination, and building a hierarchical supplier system (head/potential/long-tail).
  • Familiar with the price system, certification requirements (INMETRO), delivery time, credit period and payment habits (OA 90 days, letter of credit installments) of the Brazilian MRO market.

2. MRO Category Procurement and Cost Management

  • Responsible for the full-category MRO procurement in Brazil, undertaking customer needs, and completing the entire process of inquiry, price comparison, negotiation, order placement, fulfillment, reconciliation and settlement.
  • Formulate category procurement strategies, price systems and cost targets, optimize procurement costs, and improve price competitiveness, gross profit and inventory turnover.
  • Analyze the supply and demand, competitors, prices, delivery times and policies of the Brazilian MRO market, and formulate category planning, commodity structure and stock-up strategies.

3. Customer Demand Connection and Solution Output

  • Connect with local Chinese-funded/large-scale enterprise customers in Brazil, explore MRO procurement needs, and provide one-stop procurement solutions, cost optimization, delivery guarantee and inventory management.
  • Coordinate the entire link of cross-border procurement, local procurement, customs clearance, logistics fulfillment and local delivery to ensure timely, compliant and low-cost delivery.
  • Maintain customer relationships, improve repurchase rate, satisfaction and penetration rate, and promote large customer signing, project landing and category expansion.

4. Supply Chain Operation and Data Management

  • Responsible for the entire link operation of MRO inventory, orders, delivery, reconciliation and settlement, ensuring healthy inventory, timely delivery, compliant credit period and fund safety.
  • Track data such as sales, procurement, cost, gross profit, inventory and delivery time, and output weekly/monthly/analysis reports to support business decisions.
  • Coordinate with JD Industrial's global procurement, cross-border logistics, digital systems, risk control and compliance teams to ensure coordinated, efficient and compliant business operations.

5. Compliance and Risk Management

  • Familiar with Brazilian compliance requirements such as import tariffs, INMETRO certification, commodity inspection, customs declaration, taxation, foreign exchange and labor laws, ensuring that procurement and delivery are legal and compliant.
  • Control supplier risks, price risks, delivery risks, inventory risks, fund risks and compliance risks.

III. Job Requirements

1. Core Competencies (Must-Have)

  • Local MRO Supplier Resources in Brazil : Must have local MRO industrial product supplier resources in Brazil (tools, electrical, labor protection, hydraulic, transmission, chemical, spare parts, etc.).
  • MRO Procurement Professional Ability : 3-5 years of MRO industrial product procurement experience in Brazil/Latin America, familiar with MRO categories, products, prices, certifications, delivery times, credit periods and procurement processes.
  • In-depth Understanding of the Brazilian Market : Familiar with Brazil's industrial market, customer structure, supplier ecology, price system, certification (INMETRO), tariffs, foreign exchange and payment habits.

2. Professional Skills

  • Business Negotiation : Strong ability in price negotiation, negotiation, contract signing and supplier management.
  • Cost and Data Analysis : Price-sensitive, strong cost awareness, proficient in analyzing procurement, cost, gross profit, inventory and delivery time data.
  • Language Ability : Fluent in Portuguese (native/business level), proficient in English; fluent in Chinese is preferred.
  • Office Tools : Proficient in Excel, PPT, Word and ERP/procurement systems.

3. Comprehensive Quality

  • Business Thinking : Possess the ability of category operation, cost control, profit orientation and inventory management.
  • Customer Orientation : Customer-first, strong service awareness, demand exploration, solution output and customer maintenance.
  • Pressure Resistance and Execution : Result-oriented, strong pressure resistance, strong execution, cross-departmental collaboration and rapid implementation.
  • Compliance and Integrity : Integrity and self-discipline, strong compliance awareness, risk control and high professional quality.

4. Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or above , major in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, International Trade, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering is preferred.
  • 3-5 years of MRO industrial product procurement/sales experience in Brazil/Latin America; experience in local Brazilian supplier resources, Chinese-funded enterprise services and cross-border procurement is preferred.

IV. What We Offer

  • International Platform : JD Industrial's global business, with collaboration between the local Brazilian team and the China headquarters.
  • Salary and Benefits : Highly competitive salary + performance bonus + annual bonus + local Brazilian social security + commercial insurance + paid annual leave + overseas subsidies.
  • Development Space : Promotion paths such as MRO Category Manager, Regional Procurement & Sales Director, and JD Industrial Brazil Business Leader.
  • Localization Support : Local office in Brazil, local team, compliance support, supply chain support and customer resources.

title: Psicólogo(a) ABA
description:
Descrição da vaga

Procuramos por profissionais apaixonados por pessoas e que acreditem que, por meio da ciência do comportamento, podemos contribuir com a qualidade de vida e autonomia de indivíduos neurodiversos, principalmente aqueles que se enquadram no transtorno do espectro autista (TEA).

No Grupo Conduzir, você encontrará cultura colaborativa e ambiente descontraído, agradável e seguro para você ser quem realmente é. Não toleramos absolutamente nenhum tipo de discriminação, seja sexual, racial, social, religiosa, entre outras.

Se você se identifica com o nosso propósito e cultura, junte-se a nós!

Aplicação dos programas ABA conforme descrito em relatório e seguindo as orientações do Supervisor, prezando pela qualidade, de forma ética, mantendo o profissionalismo na relação terapeuta-cliente.

  • Atendimento a crianças (foco), adolescentes e adultos, aplicando procedimentos baseados em Análise do Comportamento Aplicada (ABA) sob supervisão, para indivíduos com desenvolvimento atípico (em sua maioria no TEA).
  • Elaboração dos registros de intervenção e acompanhamento da evolução de cada caso.
  • Participar das reuniões de equipe de cada caso.
  • Realizar Gestão do sistema interno de disponibilidade de agenda.

Graduação em Psicologia com CRP ativo ou área correlata.


Você se destacará se:

Estiver cursando Especialização em Análise do Comportamento ou Análise do Comportamento Aplicada (reconhecida pelo MEC).

Experiência em atendimento como terapeuta de indivíduos atípicos e/ou com transtornos de neurodesenvolvimento.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Pleno (React/Next.js + Node.js/Nest)
description:
Local: Presencial

Empresa: 4juris – Ecossistema de soluções, que conta com Plataforma jurídica inteligente com agentes de IA, automações e CRM integrados, que transforma atendimento e captação de clientes em resultados para escritórios de advocacia. 

Tipo: PJ 

Nível: Pleno (com ambição de crescimento acelerado)



Sobre a LEFXY

A LEFXY é uma startup inovadora que combina tecnologia, dados e inteligência artificial para automatizar e escalar a captação de clientes e o atendimento nos escritórios jurídicos — integrando CRM com WhatsApp/Instagram, automações, agentes inteligentes e dashboards de performance. 


Estamos em forte crescimento e buscamos alguém que queira crescer junto com a empresa — com carreira traçada até Tech Lead e, posteriormente, CTO.


O que esperamos de você

Como Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Pleno, você será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e manter produtos e funcionalidades chave da plataforma — tanto no frontend quanto no backend — com foco em qualidade, escalabilidade e performance.



Responsabilidades

  •  Desenvolver interfaces ricas e responsivas com React / Next.js.
  •  Construir APIs, serviços e lógica de backend com Node.js e NestJS.
  •  Trabalhar com banco de dados MongoDB e mecanismos de cache com Redis.
  •  Projetar e integrar soluções de IA / agentes inteligentes, incluindo experimentos e pipelines com ferramentas como LangChain (ou similares).
  •  Colaborar com o time de produto para transformar requisitos em soluções técnicas robustas.
  •  Garantir testes, code review, CI/CD e qualidade de código.
  •  Participar de decisões de arquitetura e conduzir melhorias contínuas.
  •  Mentorar desenvolvedores juniores conforme o time cresce.



Requisitos

  •  Experiência sólida com React / Next.js no desenvolvimento de SPA/SSR/SSG.
  •  Node.js + NestJS para backend escalável e modular.
  •  Experiência com MongoDB (modelagem, índices, performance).
  •  Experiência com Redis (cache, filas, pub/sub).
  •  Familiaridade com arquiteturas de microserviços e APIs REST/GraphQL.
  •  Experiência ou forte interesse em construir agentes de IA e integração com sistemas de LLMs (por exemplo, LangChain, OpenAI, etc.).
  •  Entendimento de devops básicos: Docker, testes automatizados, pipelines CI/CD.
  •  Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar em time ágil.



Desejável

  •  Experiência com TypeScript em frontend e backend.
  •  Conhecimento de event-driven architecture e mensageria.
  •  Experiência com cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
  •  Habilidades em mentoria / liderança técnica.



Benefícios

  • Vale alimentação (R$400/mês no Ifood benefícios).
  • Auxílio mobilidade (R$280/mês no Ifood benefícios).
  • Wellhub (gympass).
  • Dayoff de aniversário.
  • Plataforma de bem estar e terapia (Starbem).
  • Plataforma para atendimento médico, desconto em vacinas e urgência (Avus).
  • Ambiente de desenvolvimento contínuo com plano de carreira.

title: Product Solutions Consultant
description:
We believe in the power and joy of learning

At Cengage, our employees have a direct impact in helping students around the world discover the power and joy of learning. We are bonded by our shared purpose – driving innovation that helps millions of learners improve their lives and achieve their dreams through education.

Cengage's Higher Education business, Cengage, supports learning and student success by providing materials and digital solutions to faculty and students enrolled in two-year, four-year and vocational programs. We currently serve more than 10 million of the 18 million students in US higher ed. Setting a new standard of service for our customers, we deliver quality, easy-to-use course materials from textbooks and eBooks to courseware such as MindTap and WebAssign. In the US, we offer Cengage Unlimited and Cengage Unlimited for Institutions. We help instructors be better teachers, we help institutions solve problems and we empower students to leverage the power and joy of learning to transform lives.


Our culture values inclusion, engagement, and discovery

Our business is driven by our strong culture, and we know that creating an inclusive workplace is absolutely essential to the success of our company and our learners, as well as our individual well-being. We recognize the value of diverse perspectives in everything we do, and strive to ensure employees of all levels and backgrounds feel empowered to voice their ideas and bring their authentic selves to work. We achieve these priorities through programs, benefits, and initiatives that are integrated into the fabric of how we work every day. To learn more, please see


Job Overview

The Product Solutions Consultant plays a critical role in advancing strategic sales opportunities by elevating the value conversation and providing the critical expertise required to move deals toward successful closure. Serving as a trusted advisor to customers and internal partners, this role enhances and supports the efforts of both our internal sales teams and the sales organizations of our external partners as we drive toward our goal of driving adoption of Cengage Learning Platforms (CLP) within our markets.

The Product Solutions Consultant translates customer needs into compelling, outcome‑focused solution designs, using deep product knowledge, advanced communication skills, and a consultative approach. By guiding customers through technical, functional, and strategic evaluations, this role ensures that our solutions are clearly articulated, competitively positioned, and aligned with each customer’s strategic objectives.


What you'll do here:

  • Customer Engagement & Discovery : Conduct discovery sessions with partners to understand strategic goals, challenges, and success criteria. Build credibility with technical, academic, and executive audiences. Deliver high-impact digital demos, competitive pitches, and return on investment articulation aligned to customer use cases and buying criteria
  • Solution Design & Value Narrative : Own solution design and value narrative in complex deals, integrating CG learning platforms (CLP), Higher Ed, Gale, English Language Learning (ELL), and adjacent portfolios into propositions based on outcomes. Develop tailored solution architectures and value propositions that align customer needs with our products and services. Integrate cross portfolio offerings into cohesive, recommendations based on outcomes.
  • Sales Enablement & Deal Support : Partners closely with Sales Executives to accelerate pipeline velocity and improve win rates of complex opportunities by de-risking deals early and resolving technical, pedagogical, and adoption concerns and strengthen competitive positioning. Deliver compelling demos, presentations, proof of concept, and return on investment/value modeling.
  • Technical & Functional Expertise : In partnership with Customer Success, address technical, pedagogical, integration, and adoption considerations throughout the sales cycle. Serve as the expert for product capabilities and best practices.
  • Customer Advocacy & Feedback Loop : Provide structured insights from the field to Product, Marketing, and Enablement teams to inform roadmap decisions, improve messaging, and enhance competitive readiness.
  • Cross Functional Collaboration : Work closely with teams in Sales, Customer Success, Product, Implementation, and Marketing teams to ensure solution alignment, smooth transitions, and strong customer outcomes.


Skills you will need here:

  • Minimum of 5 years experience in EdTech, sales, marketing or product
  • Successful customer-facing experience with a strong preference for candidates with a consistent track record in sales, pre-sales, customer success, consultative selling, or solution development.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and storytelling skills
  • Highly motivated by collaboration and team work, particularly with the sales team
  • High degree of digital fluency; comfort with demonstrating technology platforms and answering questions
  • Ability to translate complex requirements into clear, impactful and simple solutions
  • Proficiency in leading discovery conversations and influencing diverse partners
  • Comfort working on complex, multiproduct deals and collaborating across cross functional teams and product deals
  • Experience with CRM such as Salesforce
  • Minimum B2 level of English skills per Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR)
  • Ability to travel to customers, sales meetings, etc. up to 40%
  • Experience as an english language teacher is desired
  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, education/instructional design, information technology/computer science, or a related field, or equivalent knowledge and experience


Cengage is committed to working with broad talent pools to attract and hire strong and most qualified individuals. Our job applicants are considered regardless of any classification protected by applicable federal, state, provincial or local laws.

Cengage is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities including during our job application process. If you are an applicant with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in our job application process, please contact us at .


About Cengage

Cengage, a global education technology company serving millions of learners, provides affordable, quality digital products and services that equip students with the skills and competencies needed to be job ready. For more than 100 years, we have enabled the power and joy of learning with trusted, engaging content, and now, integrated digital platforms. We serve the higher education, workforce skills, secondary education, English language teaching and research markets worldwide. Through our scalable technology, including MindTap and Cengage Unlimited, we support all learners who seek to improve their lives and achieve their dreams through education.

title: Product Solutions Consultant
description:
We believe in the power and joy of learning

At Cengage, our employees have a direct impact in helping students around the world discover the power and joy of learning. We are bonded by our shared purpose – driving innovation that helps millions of learners improve their lives and achieve their dreams through education.

Cengage's Higher Education business, Cengage, supports learning and student success by providing materials and digital solutions to faculty and students enrolled in two-year, four-year and vocational programs. We currently serve more than 10 million of the 18 million students in US higher ed. Setting a new standard of service for our customers, we deliver quality, easy-to-use course materials from textbooks and eBooks to courseware such as MindTap and WebAssign. In the US, we offer Cengage Unlimited and Cengage Unlimited for Institutions. We help instructors be better teachers, we help institutions solve problems and we empower students to leverage the power and joy of learning to transform lives.


Our culture values inclusion, engagement, and discovery

Our business is driven by our strong culture, and we know that creating an inclusive workplace is absolutely essential to the success of our company and our learners, as well as our individual well-being. We recognize the value of diverse perspectives in everything we do, and strive to ensure employees of all levels and backgrounds feel empowered to voice their ideas and bring their authentic selves to work. We achieve these priorities through programs, benefits, and initiatives that are integrated into the fabric of how we work every day. To learn more, please see


Job Overview

The Product Solutions Consultant plays a critical role in advancing strategic sales opportunities by elevating the value conversation and providing the critical expertise required to move deals toward successful closure. Serving as a trusted advisor to customers and internal partners, this role enhances and supports the efforts of both our internal sales teams and the sales organizations of our external partners as we drive toward our goal of driving adoption of Cengage Learning Platforms (CLP) within our markets.

The Product Solutions Consultant translates customer needs into compelling, outcome‑focused solution designs, using deep product knowledge, advanced communication skills, and a consultative approach. By guiding customers through technical, functional, and strategic evaluations, this role ensures that our solutions are clearly articulated, competitively positioned, and aligned with each customer’s strategic objectives.


What you'll do here:

  • Customer Engagement & Discovery : Conduct discovery sessions with partners to understand strategic goals, challenges, and success criteria. Build credibility with technical, academic, and executive audiences. Deliver high-impact digital demos, competitive pitches, and return on investment articulation aligned to customer use cases and buying criteria
  • Solution Design & Value Narrative : Own solution design and value narrative in complex deals, integrating CG learning platforms (CLP), Higher Ed, Gale, English Language Learning (ELL), and adjacent portfolios into propositions based on outcomes. Develop tailored solution architectures and value propositions that align customer needs with our products and services. Integrate cross portfolio offerings into cohesive, recommendations based on outcomes.
  • Sales Enablement & Deal Support : Partners closely with Sales Executives to accelerate pipeline velocity and improve win rates of complex opportunities by de-risking deals early and resolving technical, pedagogical, and adoption concerns and strengthen competitive positioning. Deliver compelling demos, presentations, proof of concept, and return on investment/value modeling.
  • Technical & Functional Expertise : In partnership with Customer Success, address technical, pedagogical, integration, and adoption considerations throughout the sales cycle. Serve as the expert for product capabilities and best practices.
  • Customer Advocacy & Feedback Loop : Provide structured insights from the field to Product, Marketing, and Enablement teams to inform roadmap decisions, improve messaging, and enhance competitive readiness.
  • Cross Functional Collaboration : Work closely with teams in Sales, Customer Success, Product, Implementation, and Marketing teams to ensure solution alignment, smooth transitions, and strong customer outcomes.


Skills you will need here:

  • Minimum of 5 years experience in EdTech, sales, marketing or product
  • Successful customer-facing experience with a strong preference for candidates with a consistent track record in sales, pre-sales, customer success, consultative selling, or solution development.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and storytelling skills
  • Highly motivated by collaboration and team work, particularly with the sales team
  • High degree of digital fluency; comfort with demonstrating technology platforms and answering questions
  • Ability to translate complex requirements into clear, impactful and simple solutions
  • Proficiency in leading discovery conversations and influencing diverse partners
  • Comfort working on complex, multiproduct deals and collaborating across cross functional teams and product deals
  • Experience with CRM such as Salesforce
  • Minimum B2 level of English skills per Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR)
  • Ability to travel to customers, sales meetings, etc. up to 40%
  • Experience as an english language teacher is desired
  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, education/instructional design, information technology/computer science, or a related field, or equivalent knowledge and experience


Cengage is committed to working with broad talent pools to attract and hire strong and most qualified individuals. Our job applicants are considered regardless of any classification protected by applicable federal, state, provincial or local laws.

Cengage is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities including during our job application process. If you are an applicant with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in our job application process, please contact us at .


About Cengage

Cengage, a global education technology company serving millions of learners, provides affordable, quality digital products and services that equip students with the skills and competencies needed to be job ready. For more than 100 years, we have enabled the power and joy of learning with trusted, engaging content, and now, integrated digital platforms. We serve the higher education, workforce skills, secondary education, English language teaching and research markets worldwide. Through our scalable technology, including MindTap and Cengage Unlimited, we support all learners who seek to improve their lives and achieve their dreams through education.

title: Analista Ambiental SR
description:
Buscamos profissionais com formação em Engenharia Ambiental, Florestal, Agronomia, Ciências Biológicas ou áreas correlatas para atuar na gestão ambiental de operações agrícolas, industriais e de infraestrutura.


O(a) profissional será responsável por conduzir processos de licenciamento ambiental, outorgas de recursos hídricos (IGAM e ANA), acompanhamento de condicionantes, auditorias e certificações como Bonsucro e RenovaBio.


Também atuará no monitoramento de áreas ambientais (APP, Reserva Legal), projetos de restauração florestal, gestão de resíduos (PGRS/PGRSS), controle de indicadores, uso de ferramentas geoespaciais e acompanhamento de fornecedores.


A posição exige forte atuação técnica, visão sistêmica, organização e interface com órgãos reguladores, além de gestão de contratos, custos e apoio a auditorias internas e externas.


Local de Residência:

Brasilândia de Minas/João Pinheiro/Paracatu- MG


Venha fazer parte de um time comprometido com sustentabilidade e excelência operacional!


Observação: Analisaremos somente os currículos aderentes à descrição da vaga.

title: Analista Comercial Sr
description:
Analista Comercial Sênior – Varejo

Buscamos um(a) Analista Comercial Sênior para atuar em uma estrutura de lojas próprias de varejo físico , com foco em execução comercial e performance de PDV .

A posição combina análise estratégica e atuação prática , com presença constante em loja e forte interação com times operacionais e áreas corporativas.

É uma oportunidade para profissionais que conseguem transitar nas atividades operacionais e estratégicas.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Garantir a execução da estratégia comercial nas lojas próprias
  • Monitorar indicadores de performance
  • Criar, acompanhar e conduzir planos de ação junto aos coordenadores de loja
  • Traduzir análises e dados em ações práticas de PDV
  • Realizar auditorias operacionais e garantir conformidade com normas, processos internos e diretrizes corporativas
  • Realizar follow-ups recorrentes com as lojas, identificando desvios e oportunidades
  • Interface constante com áreas internas como Comercial, BI, Logística e Operações
  • Garantir a execução de treinamentos corporativos nas lojas
  • Ter disponibilidade para viagens


Requisitos:

  • Vivência sólida em varejo físico, preferencialmente em lojas próprias ou franquias
  • Experiência em funções comerciais/operacionais no varejo
  • Excel avançado
  • Experiência com sistemas de gestão e frente de caixa
  • Forte capacidade analítica e raciocínio lógico
  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e direta
  • Perfil orientado a resultados, com alto senso de execução e disciplina
  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Marketing, Logística ou áreas correlatas


Diferenciais:

  • Pós-graduação
  • Power BI
  • Conhecimento de idiomas

title: Analista de RH Pleno | People Operations & Departamento Pessoal - Temporário
description:
Analista de RH Pleno | People Operations & Departamento Pessoal - Temporário


• Contrato: Temporário

• Modelo: Híbrido

• Local: São Paulo - SP



SOBRE A VAGA

Buscamos um(a) Analista de RH Pleno para atuar nas rotinas do time de People Operations de uma grande empresa de tecnologia. Você será o ponto de referência dos colaboradores em questões trabalhistas, conduzirá desligamentos com autonomia e manterá a conformidade legal em um ambiente de alta demanda e ritmo acelerado.

Se você tem sólida experiência em Departamento Pessoal, gosta de resolver problemas com agilidade e trabalha bem de forma autônoma, esta vaga é para você.



RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS

•      Atender colaboradores via People Support e Jira, respondendo dúvidas sobre folha, legislação trabalhista e processos de People Operations com autonomia e qualidade.

•      Conduzir o processo de desligamento end-to-end: comunicação às áreas envolvidas, cálculo e conferência de rescisões, envio da documentação demissional e assinatura do kit demissional.

•      Garantir o cumprimento dos fluxos de corte de acessos, agendamento e realização de exames demissionais e recolhimento de equipamentos.

•      Responder e-mails de colaboradores e ex-colaboradores com clareza, agilidade e qualidade.

•      Atuar de forma preventiva na identificação de riscos trabalhistas e inconsistências nos processos, propondo melhorias.

•      Apoiar a liderança e áreas parceiras com informações e análises sobre desligamentos e rotinas de DP.



REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS

•      Experiência sólida em Departamento Pessoal / People Operations (mínimo 3 anos).

•      Domínio em cálculo de rescisão trabalhista e legislação de desligamento.

•      Vivência com ferramentas de chamados (Jira, ServiceNow ou similares).

•      Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, organização e senso de responsabilidade.



REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

•      Experiência em empresas de tecnologia, plataformas digitais ou startups.

•      Conhecimento em SAP HCM ou SuccessFactors.


O QUE OFERECEMOS

•      Exposição a processos e ferramentas de gestão de pessoas de nível internacional.

•      Equipe experiente e cultura colaborativa.

•      Remuneração compatível com o mercado para contrato temporário.

•      Modelo híbrido de trabalho em São Paulo - SP.

title: Estágio em recepção
description:
Apresentação do cargo:


Apoiar a equipe de Recepção nas operações diárias de front office, auxiliando nos processos de check-in e check-out, atendimento telefônico, gestão de reservas, esclarecimento de dúvidas dos hóspedes, controle de disponibilidade de apartamentos, coordenação com outros departamentos e resolução de situações cotidianas, desenvolvendo habilidades práticas em atendimento ao cliente, uso de sistemas de gestão hoteleira (PMS), técnicas de comunicação eficaz e manutenção dos padrões de qualidade e hospitalidade do hotel.


Responsabilidades e atividades:


  • Auxiliar nos processos de check-in e check-out de hóspedes;
  • Apoiar no atendimento telefônico e encaminhamento de ligações;
  • Auxiliar na gestão de reservas e consulta de disponibilidade de apartamentos;
  • Apoiar no esclarecimento de dúvidas sobre serviços, tarifas e facilidades do hotel;
  • Auxiliar no cadastro e atualização de informações de hóspedes no sistema (PMS;)
  • Apoiar na emissão de faturas, recibos e documentos fiscais;
  • Auxiliar na coordenação com housekeeping sobre status de apartamentos;
  • Apoiar no controle de chaves e acessos dos hóspedes ;
  • Auxiliar no registro e encaminhamento de solicitações especiais;
  • Apoiar na organização de documentos e arquivos da recepção;
  • Auxiliar no atendimento presencial e resolução de demandas simples;
  • Apoiar na comunicação entre turnos e repasse de informações importantes.


Requisitos:


  • Ensino superior em andamento em Hotelaria, Turismo, Administração ou áreas correlatas
  • Disponibilidade para estagiar no mínimo 6 meses
  • Inglês: Avançado

title: Psicólogo(a) ABA
description:
Descrição da vaga

Procuramos por profissionais apaixonados por pessoas e que acreditem que, por meio da ciência do comportamento, podemos contribuir com a qualidade de vida e autonomia de indivíduos neurodiversos, principalmente aqueles que se enquadram no transtorno do espectro autista (TEA).

No Grupo Conduzir, você encontrará cultura colaborativa e ambiente descontraído, agradável e seguro para você ser quem realmente é. Não toleramos absolutamente nenhum tipo de discriminação, seja sexual, racial, social, religiosa, entre outras.

Se você se identifica com o nosso propósito e cultura, junte-se a nós!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Aplicação dos programas ABA conforme descrito em relatório e seguindo as orientações do Supervisor, prezando pela qualidade, de forma ética, mantendo o profissionalismo na relação terapeuta-cliente.

  • Atendimento a crianças (foco), adolescentes e adultos, aplicando procedimentos baseados em Análise do Comportamento Aplicada (ABA) sob supervisão, para indivíduos com desenvolvimento atípico (em sua maioria no TEA).
  • Elaboração dos registros de intervenção e acompanhamento da evolução de cada caso.
  • Participar das reuniões de equipe de cada caso.
  • Realizar Gestão do sistema interno de disponibilidade de agenda.

Requisitos e qualificações

Graduação em Psicologia com CRP ativo ou área correlata.


Você se destacará se:

Estiver cursando Especialização em Análise do Comportamento ou Análise do Comportamento Aplicada (reconhecida pelo MEC).

Experiência em atendimento como terapeuta de indivíduos atípicos e/ou com transtornos de neurodesenvolvimento.

title: E-commerce Operations Specialist
description:
Junior E-commerce Operations Specialist

Location: Paraíso, São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid: 3 days on-site, 2 days remote)

Employment Type: CLT

Reporting to: Head of Brazil Business

About the Role

Our client is a fast-growing international e-commerce agency expanding our footprint in Brazil. We are looking for a highly analytical and execution-driven Junior E-commerce Operations Specialist to support the daily operations of top-tier FMCG brands.

This is a unique, high-growth opportunity to work closely with the country head, gain exposure to advanced cross-border e-commerce strategies, and build a strong foundation in the rapidly evolving social commerce landscape.

Your 90-Day Mission

Successfully take ownership of and execute the daily operational routines for 1–2 major brand stores on TikTok Shop, demonstrating a solid understanding of platform mechanics and delivering accurate daily and weekly performance reports.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Reporting (Core)

  • Extract, clean, and analyze daily operational data
  • Use advanced Excel functions (e.g., VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, logical formulas)
  • Track key metrics such as GMV, conversion rates, and campaign performance
  • Provide actionable insights to improve operational performance

Platform Operations

  • Support daily operations across local e-commerce platforms
  • Experience with TikTok Shop is a strong plus; Mercado Livre, Shopee, or Amazon is also relevant
  • Ensure smooth execution of campaigns, product listings, and promotions

Creator / Affiliate Execution

  • Execute outreach and onboarding of local influencers and creators
  • Support affiliate program operations based on defined guidelines

Client Communication Support

  • Act as a cultural and linguistic bridge during client interactions
  • Translate local client needs into clear internal action points
  • Support communication between local teams and international stakeholders

Who You Are

Languages

  • Native Portuguese
  • Fluent business-level English (mandatory)

Experience

  • 1–2 years of hands-on experience in e-commerce operations
  • Experience in social commerce is a plus but not required

Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel
  • Comfortable working with large datasets and applying analytical logic

Soft Skills

  • High learning agility and curiosity
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Execution-focused with a proactive mindset

What We Offer

  • Competitive CLT salary
  • Flexible hybrid work model (Paraíso area)
  • Direct mentorship from international e-commerce experts
  • Fast-paced, high-growth working environment
  • Exposure to global best practices in e-commerce and social commerce

title: Assistente de Planejamento Sr
description:
Sobre a LongPing:


A LongPing High-Tech é uma empresa global de sementes, presente em 6 países e está entre uma das líderes do segmento no mercado brasileiro.

Seu portfólio, resultado de investimentos constantes em pesquisa e tecnologia, inclui híbridos que oferecem estabilidade e alto potencial produtivo atendendo com agilidade as necessidades do agricultor.

Com orgulho, somos parte do CITIC Group, o maior conglomerado econômico da China reconhecido pelo mercado pela excelência em produtos e tecnologia.



Responsabilidades:


Apoiar a execução e governança dos processos de S&OP, Demanda e DRP (Plano de distribuição de produtos), garantindo qualidade e consistência das informações.

Consolidar, tratar e analisar dados de demanda, estoque e distribuição para suporte às decisões do planejamento.

Desenvolver, atualizar e automatizar dashboards e relatórios em Power BI.

Monitorar KPIs como forecast accuracy, OTIF, níveis de estoque, cobertura e utilização de recursos logísticos.

Apoiar o planejamento e acompanhamento de transferências (DRP), incluindo análise de desbalanceamento de estoques.

Dar suporte na criação e atualização de documentos logísticos (ex.: STO/DN) e acompanhamento de pedidos.

Auxiliar na preparação do ciclo mensal de S&OP, incluindo consolidação de dados e atualização de indicadores.

Apoiar análises de inventário, capacidade de armazenagem e atendimento de exceções operacionais.

Mapear, documentar e melhorar processos da área, buscando ganho de eficiência e padronização.

Atuar como ponto de suporte analítico para o time, garantindo organização, rastreabilidade e confiabilidade das informações.



Requisitos:


Desejável Ensino Superior completo ou em andamento em Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência com análise de dados, controle de indicadores e suporte a processos operacionais.

Desejável experiência em áreas de Planejamento (Demanda, S&OP ou DRP).

Desejável experiência em ambientes com alta complexidade operacional ou sazonalidade (ex.: agronegócio).

Conhecimento em Power Query e automação de relatórios será considerado um diferencial.

Excel avançado

Power BI intermediário (criação e manutenção de dashboards).

Desejável conhecimento em SAP (MM/SD).



Oportunidade e Inclusão:


Nós da LongPing, buscamos promover a inclusão e incentivamos que profissionais com deficiência se inscrevam diretamente nas vagas divulgadas que tenham interesse, dentre todas as oportunidades oferecidas.

A LongPing agradece o seu interesse em fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
Recognized as the leading software development company in the Americas, our client offers 100% remote modality and an excellent work environment where employees can thrive and work in multicultural teams with flexible schedules and endless growth opportunities.


About the Role:


We are looking for Senior Java Developer to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!


These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Main Activities:


- Work with software development teams to gather requirements and ensure best practices are adhered to.

- Design, Implement & Support solutions for application development, security, analytics, and performance management.

description:
Propósito da função:

Conduzir e orquestrar a jornada do paciente dentro da clínica, garantindo fluidez, organização e uma experiência de alto padrão, antecipando necessidades e assegurando que cada etapa aconteça com excelência.


Principais Responsabilidades: 

  • Condução da Jornada do Paciente
  • Recepcionar o paciente e assumir a condução da sua jornada dentro da clínica;
  • Direcionar o paciente entre as etapas do atendimento (recepção, avaliação, procedimentos, etc.);
  • Garantir que o fluxo aconteça sem atrasos, ruídos ou esperas desnecessárias;
  • Manter o paciente sempre orientado sobre o que vai acontecer a seguir.


Orquestração e Fluidez Operacional

  • Acompanhar o cronograma dos atendimentos em tempo real;
  • Alinhar com a equipe para garantir sincronia entre etapas;
  • Identificar gargalos ou atrasos e agir rapidamente para reorganizar o fluxo;
  • Garantir que cada ambiente esteja pronto antes da chegada do paciente.


Antecipação e Experiência (Perfil Concierge)

  • Observar o comportamento e necessidades do paciente ao longo da jornada;
  • Antecipar demandas (água, café, conforto, dúvidas, tempo de espera);
  • Criar uma experiência personalizada, acolhedora e fluida;
  • Atuar de forma discreta, mas presente, transmitindo cuidado e atenção constante.


Gestão e Indexação de Dados

  • Registrar informações relevantes da jornada do paciente;
  • Atualizar sistemas e controles internos com dados de atendimento;
  • Mapear pontos de melhoria na experiência e reportar à gestão;
  • Garantir organização e confiabilidade das informações.


Remuneração:

  • R$ 1.650,00 (registro em carteira)
  • Insalubridade 20%
  • R$ 700,00 de ticket Alimentação/Refeição
  • Vale transporte
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico

title: Clinical Applications Specialist
description:
Job Title: Clinical Applications Specialist – Ultrasound (Independent Contractor)

Location: Brazil (São Paulo preferred or remote with travel)

Engagement Type: Independent Contractor / Consultant Agreement (Full-time dedication required)

Company: CHISON Medical Imaging


Position Overview

We are seeking a Clinical Applications Specialist – Ultrasound to partner with CHISON as an independent contractor on a full-time consultancy basis . You will serve as the local clinical expert supporting our ultrasound business in Brazil, providing clinical and technical expertise during the sales cycle, delivering product training to customers, and building relationships with clinical users. This role requires hands-on clinical experience with ultrasound systems and full professional proficiency in Portuguese and English .

You will operate under a consultant service agreement (not an employment contract). The role requires full-time dedication during the contract term. You retain the flexibility to manage your own work schedule.


Core Responsibilities

  • Provide ultrasound-specific clinical and technical expertise during the sales cycle, demonstrating CHISON ultrasound systems to potential customers.
  • Develop and deliver product training and clinical education on ultrasound equipment operation, image optimization, and clinical applications to local sales teams and end users.
  • Create and validate clinical content (e.g., case studies, application notes) showcasing CHISON ultrasound solutions (General Imaging, Vascular, OB/GYN).
  • Support marketing activities (webinars, seminars, trade shows) by performing ultrasound product demonstrations.
  • Build and maintain relationships with local clinical users and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) in the ultrasound community.
  • Monitor customer installations and provide post-sale clinical support to ensure high customer satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with global sales team to relay market feedback.



Skills & Qualifications

Mandatory Requirements:

  • Clinical Ultrasound Experience: Minimum 2–3 years of hands-on experience performing diagnostic ultrasound examinations in a clinical setting. Proficiency in General Imaging/Abdominal and Vascular sonography is required.
  • ARDMS or equivalent sonography registry/certification is strongly preferred.
  • Language & Location:
  • Full professional proficiency in Portuguese (written and spoken) – mandatory.
  • Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) – mandatory.
  • Must be based in Brazil and legally authorized to work as an independent contractor.
  • Availability: Full-time dedication to the project during the contract term (approximately 40 hours per week). You determine your own daily schedule.


Preferred Skills:

  • Previous experience as a Clinical Applications Specialist , Ultrasound Technologist , or in a clinical support role within an ultrasound manufacturer.
  • Additional clinical knowledge in Cardiac or OB/GYN ultrasound.
  • Willingness to travel domestically within Brazil.


Engagement Terms (Consultant Agreement)

  • Contract type: Independent contractor / service provider agreement (not an employment contract).
  • Working arrangement: Full-time dedication to CHISON during the contract term. You manage your own work schedule and are not required to follow fixed office hours.
  • Compensation: Monthly service fee to be agreed (paid upon invoice submission).
  • Tax & benefits: You are responsible for your own taxes, social security, health insurance, and any statutory benefits.
  • Expenses: Travel and customer-related expenses reimbursed according to company policy.



What We Offer

  • Opportunity to serve as the local clinical expert for a global ultrasound company.
  • Collaborative and international work environment.
  • Competitive monthly service fee (to be discussed).
  • Flexible scheduling – you control your own working hours.

title: Desenvolvedor Web Full Stack
description:
Sobre a Empresa

A Campos Dealer é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada no desenvolvimento de sistemas de CRM para concessionárias agrícolas e de máquinas de construção. Entregamos soluções integradas para a gestão de vendas, peças e serviços, apoiando nossos clientes na evolução contínua de seus processos e resultados.


Nosso ambiente de trabalho é dinâmico, ágil e colaborativo, valorizando a paixão por tecnologia, a inovação e o aprendizado contínuo. Atuamos com uma ampla variedade de ferramentas e tecnologias, desenvolvendo soluções modernas que impulsionam a transformação digital do setor.


Sobre o Cargo

Buscamos um profissional Pleno com sólida experiência em Desenvolvimento Full Stack Web para atuar de forma estratégica em nosso time de engenharia. Esta posição é fundamental para arquitetar, desenvolver e otimizar aplicações críticas, sendo responsável por todo o ciclo de vida do software.


O profissional atuará como uma referência técnica, possuindo visão sistêmica para resolver problemas complexos e apoiar tanto a evolução de sistemas legados quanto a implementação de novas iniciativas tecnológicas, incluindo integrações com Inteligência Artificial e sistemas de mensageria.


Responsabilidades

  • Codificação e Arquitetura: Desenvolver e manter aplicações web robustas utilizando .NET (C#), garantindo a entrega de código limpo, testável e escalável.
  • Engenharia de Banco de Dados: Criar e otimizar procedures complexas, views e consultas em SQL Server, com foco em análise de planos de execução e resolução de gargalos de performance.
  • Integração de Sistemas: Conduzir integrações com APIs de terceiros, como ERPs, CRMs, WhatsApp , definindo fluxos de dados e estratégias de tratamento de erros.
  • Mentoria Técnica: Apoiar desenvolvedores em níveis iniciais e auxiliando na resolução de impedimentos lógicos e técnicos.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Sólida experiência com C# e ecossistema .NET (Framework e Core).
  • Domínio de SQL Server (T-SQL), com expertise em Performance Tuning e criação de procedures complexas.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento front-end com JavaScript, jQuery, HTML5 e CSS.
  • Vivência avançada no consumo e desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git ou SVN).
  • Alta capacidade de depuração (debug) de aplicações web em ambas as camadas (front e back-end).
  • Aplicação prática de boas práticas de segurança, desempenho e escalabilidade.


Informações Adicionais

Contrato de Trabalho: CLT

Modelo: Presencial no bairro Água Verde (Curitiba)

Remuneração: A combinar de acordo com a senioridade e experiência técnica

⏰ Jornada: 40h semanais

title: Consultor Funcional SAP Data Migration
description:
O que procuramos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) Funcional SAP com foco em Data Migration para atuar em projetos estratégicos de SAP S/4HANA, contribuindo diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e governança dos dados em ambientes de migração.


Atribuições principais:

  • Desenvolver, documentar e executar a estratégia de extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL).
  • Liderar e operacionalizar a migração de dados utilizando o SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit (LTMC / Migrate Your Data).
  • Garantir a limpeza (data cleansing), consistência e qualidade dos dados mestres e transacionais provenientes de sistemas legados.
  • Realizar análises, reconciliações e validações de dados antes e após a carga no S/4HANA.
  • Atuar em parceria com times funcionais e técnicos para assegurar a aderência aos requisitos de negócio.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada com SAP Data Migration, utilizando SAP Data Services e/ou S/4HANA Migration Cockpit.
  • Conhecimento nas estruturas de objetos de migração do SAP S/4HANA.
  • Excel avançado, com foco em reconciliação e validação de dados.
  • Inglês nível B2 (conversação e escrita), para interação em ambiente profissional


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em projetos de implementação ou rollout S/4HANA.
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes corporativos do segmento automotivo.
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de governança e qualidade de dados.

title: Cost Specialist
description:
Position: Cost Specialist

Location: Via Anchieta

Role Summary:

This is an exciting opportunity for someone with a strong desire to learn, develop professionally, and deliver outstanding, high-quality work, making a difference at Colgate. Here you will take ownership of the end-to-end financial reporting, ensuring the integrity of financial statements and driving continuous process optimization to support organizational growth and transformation. In this role, excellent communication abilities to collaborate with various departments and across functions is key, and use your expertise to ensure accurate and actionable insights for senior leadership.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the comprehensive end-to-end Cost of Sales/MYR (LE) planning and reporting cycle, including the preparation and review of all necessary exhibits.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams in managing the planning of the focus factory spending and ensuring key budget targets (Cost per Ton, VCC and NVO’s) are being delivered, also, attention to headcount, labour costs, utilities cost, maintenance spending and fixed conversion costs.
  • Drive the monthly reporting process:
  • Provide timely VCC and NVO reports and insightful commentary to functional leaders.
  • Responsible for the month-end financial closes and collaborating with CBS to achieve timely closes and maintain the financial integrity and accuracy of data.
  • Balance Sheet reconciliation of prepaid and accrual accounts, as well as GR/IR un-vouchered accounts, and monthly review of capital spending (MWIP) to ensure projects are on time and within budget.
  • Responsible for the quarterly standard cost calculation and managing the process to ensure a timely submission of costs and intercompany prices for both materials and finished goods, imperative to collaborate with Global CBS, ensuring master data accurancy and reviewing rate routing and providing all explanation needed for significant cost changes

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or related field.
  • Diversified financial experience, ideally within supply chain finance, reporting, analysis, and budgeting.
  • Intermediate English.
  • Advanced proficiency in Google Suite and demonstrated experience with SAP.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, oral, and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in the Consumer Goods industry or a multinational corporate environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional collaboration and influence without authority.
  • Strong learning agility—comfortable with change, continuous improvement, and process innovation.
  • Assertive communicator with proven negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Commitment to Colgate core values: teamwork, integrity, caring, and customer focus.

title: Project Coordinator – Renovations, Permits & Timelines
description:
Project Coordinator – Renovations, Permits & Timelines


Why Work for Us?


At Blue Gems, we're obsessed with building smart, efficient systems that keep vacation rentals running seamlessly. We manage over 150 short-term rental homes in Florida, handling everything from guest experience to maintenance and cleaning, so our property owners and guests can enjoy peace of mind.

We're a lean, global team of 25+ (primarily in LATAM) who value ownership, honesty, and making things better every day. We offer stable, long-term roles with bimonthly pay and plenty of opportunities to grow with us.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy coordinating multiple moving parts, and want to be part of a high-performing team, keep reading.


Who We Are and What We Are Looking For

We're looking for a Project Coordinator who can keep calm under pressure, coordinate multiple moving parts, and manage renovation projects across our portfolio, including renovations, designs, permits, and timelines.

This isn't a quiet desk job, its active coordination, follow-ups, and ensuring projects move forward without delays.


Your Four Primary Responsibilities/Objectives Will Be:

  • Renovation Project Coordination – Manage multiple renovation projects, ensuring timelines and execution stay on track
  • Permits & Compliance Tracking – Coordinate permits, approvals, and ensure projects meet local requirements
  • Vendor & Contractor Coordination – Communicate with contractors and technicians to ensure work is completed correctly and on time
  • Timeline & Progress Management – Track milestones, follow up on delays, and ensure projects move forward without gaps


What Will Our Project Coordinator Look Like?


Who You Are:

  • Calm, decisive problem solver who can manage multiple ongoing projects
  • Strong communicator with clear spoken and written English and Portuguese
  • Extremely detail-oriented and highly organized
  • Tech-savvy with Notion, Airtable, Slack, Google Drive, and AI tools
  • Proactive, you spot issues early and follow through until resolved


Who You Are Not:

  • Someone who loses track of timelines or misses follow-ups
  • Passive or waiting to be told what to do
  • Disorganized or unable to manage multiple projects at once


Must-Have Qualifications:

  • Fluent Portuguese (required)
  • Strong English speaking and writing skills
  • Experience coordinating projects, renovations, or construction-related work
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Highly detail-oriented and proactive mindset
  • Comfort working with tools like Notion, Slack, Google Drive
  • 1+ years of Hospitality experience
  • 1+ years of work experience with Maintenance Management


Nice-to-Have Qualifications:

  • Experience in short-term rentals or property management
  • Familiarity with STR tools such as Guesty, Breezeway, or similar platforms (used in day-to-day operations)
  • Experience coordinating with field technicians or vendors


3 Key Responsibilities This Person Will Be Driving / Responsible For:

  • Managing renovation timelines and ensuring execution stays on track
  • Coordinating contractors, technicians, and project updates
  • Tracking permits, approvals, and project progress


Define What Success Means in This Role:

  • Projects move forward without delays or gaps
  • Contractors and technicians are aligned and informed
  • Permits and approvals are handled on time
  • All project updates and tracking are accurate and up to date


Timeframe for Success:

  • Within 30 Days: Understands current projects, tools, and workflows
  • Within 90 Days: Independently managing multiple projects and timelines
  • Within 6–12 Months: Driving improvements in project coordination and execution


Clarity as a Whole/Team:

This Role Owns:

  • Renovation project coordination
  • Contractor and vendor communication
  • Permits and compliance tracking
  • Timeline tracking and follow-ups


This Role Does Not Own:

  • Real-time maintenance dispatch
  • Direct supervision of technicians outside coordination duties
  • Guest communication unrelated to projects


Compensation:

Full-time (48 hrs/week)

$1,000 – $1,500 USD/month

Paid Time Off (PTO)

Stable, long-term role with global team


Clarity of Role:

Name the Role: Project Coordinator – Renovations, Permits & Timelines

title: Engenheiro de Dados Especialista
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Atividades:


  • Liderar a definição técnica e a evolução da estratégia de Data Lake, garantindo uma arquitetura robusta e escalável;
  • Desenhar e estruturar camadas de dados (Raw, Trusted, Refined) e fluxos de processamento baseados em padrões de ETL e ELT;
  • Estabelecer diretrizes para que a arquitetura suporte o crescimento de volume e complexidade da companhia;
  • Desenvolver e automatizar pipelines de dados complexos, garantindo a entrega eficiente para modelos preditivos e análises avançadas;
  • Otimizar continuamente o desempenho dos fluxos de dados, reduzindo latência e custos operacionais de processamento;
  • Implementar ferramentas e práticas que permitam a escalabilidade da modelagem de dados voltada à decisão estratégica;
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida da aquisição de dados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para os stakeholders;
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e confiabilidade dos dados, estabelecendo processos de monitoramento e validação;
  • Atuar como ponte entre a tecnologia e as áreas de negócio, garantindo que as soluções de dados estejam alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.


Requisitos:


  • Formação em Tecnologia.
  • Sólida experiência em pipelines e Big Data (Python/Java/Scala);
  • Vivência em liderança de equipes e metodologias ágeis;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Perfil autônomo, analítico, comunicativo e orientado a resultados.

title: Site Reliability Engineering Manager
description:
About the Team


SRE Middleware & Data (SRE M&D) enables product teams by providing secure, scalable, and automated data, middleware, and AI services on Azure.


Provisioning: Automates secure delivery of databases, queues, caches, and AI services/resources; builds self-service and guardrails.

Reliability: Ensures availability, performance, and resilience of data, middleware, and AI services in production; builds observability, autohealing, and disaster recovery.


What You Will Do


  • Lead and grow the team: Manage, mentor, and develop SRE engineers across Provisioning and Reliability.


  • Lead cross-team initiatives:


  • Align roadmaps with Architects and partner teams; ensure adoption of architecture standards.


  • Run design reviews and architecture signoffs; surface and mitigate risks and complexity early.


  • Translate standards into guardrails and automation (policyascode, selfservice) for consistent delivery.


  • Apply lightweight RACI and clear escalation paths to resolve tradeoffs quickly.


Drive roadmap and execution:


  • Provisioning: Self-service engines, Crossplane/Terraform-based automation, policy-as-code, secured pipelines, access management, backups/restore, Azure AI resource provisioning, and quota management.


  • Reliability: Observability integrations (New Relic, Azure Monitor), performance tuning, autohealing, DR/BCP, resilience testing, failover automation, SLOs, reliability for Azure AI services and messaging platforms (Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus).


Establish engineering excellence:


  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Crossplane) and CI/CD best practices.


  • Change management with safe deploys and rollback strategies.


  • Incident and problem management with blameless postmortems.


  • Continuous improvement loops measured by DORA/SRE metrics.


  • Champion security and compliance by design:


  • Policy as code, least privilege access, and secrets/identity hygiene.


  • Guardrails in self-service flows; auditability and evidence collection.


  • Partnership with Security/Compliance for standards and reviews.


Partner with the Architects:


  • Codevelop platform architecture and service standards.


  • Define SLIs/SLOs and capacity/reliability patterns for core services.


  • Align roadmaps and run design reviews for high-impact changes.


Own delivery outcomes:


  • Navigate competing priorities across a broad platform scope — balancing reactive operational load (incidents, toil, on-call) against proactive platform investment (self-service, automation, resilience) without a clean separation between the two.


  • Make and communicate prioritization decisions under ambiguity, with partial information, across teams that have conflicting urgency.


  • Maintain a defensible, visible backlog that reflects real risk and business impact — not just the loudest stakeholder.


Operate a healthy on-call:


  • High-quality playbooks and automation-first troubleshooting (AI-assisted).


  • Actionable alerts with SLO-based paging and noise reduction.


  • Regular resilience testing and post-incident hardening.


Initiatives You Will Lead:


  • Self-service provisioning for databases, queues, and caches with golden configurations and policy guardrails.


  • AI-assisted troubleshooting for provisioning and production incidents.


  • Platform wide observability integration for data, middleware, and AI services (New Relic, Azure Monitor).


  • Automated DR runbooks and resilience/chaos testing in production.


  • Performance tuning at service and query layers, including automated tuning workflows.


  • Standardization of provisioning via Terraform/Crossplane for databases, messaging, and AI services.


  • Governance for Azure AI services (quotas, access, safety guardrails) with clear consumption patterns for product teams.


Success Metrics


  • Reduced MTTR and incident count, improved SLO attainment for data/middleware services.


  • Improved lead time for change and change failure rate; increased automation coverage and reduced toil.


  • Faster time to provision and higher first success rate for self-service requests.


  • Measurable improvements in cost efficiency, performance, and capacity predictability.


  • Team health: engagement, growth, hiring velocity, stress levels, and retention.


  • SLO attainment for AI endpoints and messaging services; reduced alert noise via improved observability (New Relic/Azure Monitor).


What You Will Bring


  • Proven experience managing SRE/platform/infrastructure teams delivering production-critical services.


  • Deep familiarity with Azure and the team stack: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB; Redis; messaging systems such as CloudAMQP/RabbitMQ, Kafka, Event Hubs, and Service Bus.


  • Strong reliability fundamentals: SLOs/SLIs, incident and problem management, capacity, DR/BCP, performance tuning.


  • Solid automation background: IaC (Terraform/Crossplane), CI/CD (Azure DevOps), GitOps, policyascode, secrets and identity, RBAC.


  • Track record of building selfservice platforms and reducing toil.


  • Excellent crossfunctional leadership with product, security, and compliance partners.


  • Experience operating Azure AI services in production (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search).


  • Observability experience with New Relic, Azure Monitor, and OpenTelemetry.


What You’ll Need


  • Advanced skills in English


  • Experience with AI-assisted operations and troubleshooting.


  • Observability expertise (Prometheus/Grafana, New Relic, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry).


  • Database performance engineering and query optimization.


  • Experience in regulated environments and security frameworks.


  • FinOps capabilities (cost governance, forecasting, rightsizing, quotas, budgets, chargeback/showback).


How We Work


  • Collaboration first with a strong partnership between the Engineering Manager and the Architects.


  • Automation by default; security and reliability are nonnegotiable.


  • Blameless postmortems, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes.


  • Participation in an equitable on-call rotation with high-quality runbooks and automation.


Tech Environment


Azure (AKS, managed databases, storage, networking, identity).


Azure AI services (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search).


Azure DevOps for CI/CD.


CloudAMQP (RabbitMQ).


Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB.


Caches: Redis.


Queues/Brokers: Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus.


Terraform/Crossplane, GitOps.


Observability: New Relic, Azure Monitor, logs, metrics, traces, alerting workflows.
